{
  "units": [
    {
      "schema_version": "1.0",
      "record_type": "work_unit",
      "id": "npw-01-progress-lease-current-main",
      "initiative_id": "coordination-integrity",
      "goal_id": "no-passive-waiting",
      "design_revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c",
      "spec_revision": "npw-01-v1",
      "title": "Port truthful progress leases onto current main",
      "class": "implementation",
      "objective": "Distinguish durable advancement from heartbeat and blocker lifecycle events on the current claim/session runtime without changing ownership automatically.",
      "profile": "standard",
      "execution_class": "independently_executable",
      "claimability": "ready_for_execution",
      "authorization_mode": "registry_claim",
      "scope": {
        "included": [
          "Additive ProgressEventV1 fields and owning-session mutation",
          "Stalled classification with bounded quiet intervals",
          "Registry and session status step-down context",
          "Current-main salvage of the useful Plan 70 fixtures",
          "Correction that blocker and handoff events do not renew progress"
        ],
        "excluded": [
          "Blocker disposition or ready-queue evaluation",
          "Automatic claim release, takeover, rebase or deletion",
          "Fleet threshold tuning",
          "Workspace bootstrap edits"
        ]
      },
      "inputs": [
        {
          "kind": "bounded_design",
          "id": "docs/plans/110_no_passive_waiting_enforcement.md",
          "revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c"
        },
        {
          "kind": "historical_salvage",
          "id": "origin/plan-70-progress-leases",
          "revision": "2d56f6cf04db75789304de3af4a5503cfa822dda"
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "ProgressEventV1-compatible claim fields and mutation command",
        "One canonical stalled classifier used by registry and session status",
        "Both-sign current-main tests for heartbeat, blocker, quiet interval, legacy state and pruning"
      ],
      "dependencies": [],
      "conflict_surfaces": [
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "enforced_planning/coordination_claims.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-progress-lease"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "enforced_planning/session_lifecycle.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-progress-lease"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "enforced_planning/active_work_registry.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-progress-lease"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "tests/test_check_coordination_claims.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-progress-lease"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "tests/test_generate_active_work_registry.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-progress-lease"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "tests/test_session_cli.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-progress-lease"
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        {
          "id": "NPW01-A1",
          "criterion": "A live claim with fresh heartbeats and expired durable progress is reported stalled with exact evidence and next action while ownership remains unchanged.",
          "evidence_required": [
            "Focused claim, registry and session status tests",
            "Frozen-clock before/after progress deadline fixture",
            "Legacy-claim compatibility fixture"
          ],
          "negative_control": "Heartbeat, blocker, handoff, file dirt and stalled pruning cannot change progress_at or release the claim."
        }
      ],
      "readiness": {
        "status": "ready",
        "required_approval_types": [],
        "approvals": [],
        "failed_guards": []
      },
      "claim_policy": {
        "eligibility_rule": "One exact live registry claim owns only the progress-lease runtime, status, documentation and focused-test paths.",
        "lease_policy": "renewable",
        "lease_duration_minutes": 1440,
        "max_active_per_claimant": 1,
        "named_owner_id": null
      },
      "status": "ready",
      "record_version": 1
    },
    {
      "schema_version": "1.0",
      "record_type": "work_unit",
      "id": "npw-02-provider-free-blocker-decision",
      "initiative_id": "coordination-integrity",
      "goal_id": "no-passive-waiting",
      "design_revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c",
      "spec_revision": "npw-02-v1",
      "title": "Implement provider-free blocker and ready-queue decisions",
      "class": "implementation",
      "objective": "Return a typed deterministic disposition that distinguishes ready alternatives, path waits, verified blockers and incomplete queue knowledge without mutating claims.",
      "profile": "standard",
      "execution_class": "independently_executable",
      "claimability": "ready_for_execution",
      "authorization_mode": "registry_claim",
      "scope": {
        "included": [
          "Strict BlockerRequestV1, ReadyQueueEvaluationV1 and BlockerDispositionV1 contracts",
          "Revision-bound work-graph queue evaluation",
          "Claim-conflict and mailbox-delivery evidence inputs",
          "A/B/C and unrelated-root fixtures",
          "Read-only decision CLI"
        ],
        "excluded": [
          "Claim or tracker mutation",
          "Progress-lease implementation",
          "LLM judgment",
          "Work-graph requirement for unplanned light work",
          "Workspace bootstrap edits"
        ]
      },
      "inputs": [
        {
          "kind": "bounded_design",
          "id": "docs/plans/110_no_passive_waiting_enforcement.md",
          "revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c"
        },
        {
          "kind": "existing_contract",
          "id": "enforced_planning/plan_readiness.py",
          "revision": "812759dcb09ec2cebc5954601b418434256b31b4"
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Strict blocker and queue Pydantic contracts",
        "Pure ready-queue and blocker disposition evaluator",
        "Read-only CLI and both-sign fixtures"
      ],
      "dependencies": [],
      "conflict_surfaces": [
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "enforced_planning/blocker_policy.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-blocker-policy"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "scripts/evaluate_blocker.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-blocker-policy"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "tests/test_blocker_policy.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-blocker-policy"
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        {
          "id": "NPW02-A1",
          "criterion": "The same deterministic evaluator returns continue_ready_work for A blocked/B ready, integration_wait for a path collision, and goal_blocked_verified only for complete queue coverage with no eligible units and a supported blocker.",
          "evidence_required": [
            "Provider-free contract and decision tests",
            "A/B/C positive and negative fixture receipts",
            "Stale, missing and malformed graph tests",
            "Persisted-versus-observed mailbox tests"
          ],
          "negative_control": "Partial or unavailable queue coverage and a merely persisted mailbox message cannot produce goal_blocked_verified."
        }
      ],
      "readiness": {
        "status": "ready",
        "required_approval_types": [],
        "approvals": [],
        "failed_guards": []
      },
      "claim_policy": {
        "eligibility_rule": "One exact live registry claim owns only the new blocker-policy module, read-only CLI and focused tests.",
        "lease_policy": "renewable",
        "lease_duration_minutes": 1440,
        "max_active_per_claimant": 1,
        "named_owner_id": null
      },
      "status": "ready",
      "record_version": 1
    },
    {
      "schema_version": "1.0",
      "record_type": "work_unit",
      "id": "npw-03-safe-lifecycle-integration",
      "initiative_id": "coordination-integrity",
      "goal_id": "no-passive-waiting",
      "design_revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c",
      "spec_revision": "npw-03-v1",
      "title": "Apply blocker dispositions through safe scoped lifecycle operations",
      "class": "integration",
      "objective": "Record the deterministic disposition and either continue another unit or safely narrow, hand off, or retire only the blocked goal scope while preserving unrelated roots and dirty work.",
      "profile": "standard",
      "execution_class": "coupled",
      "claimability": "blocked_dependencies",
      "authorization_mode": "registry_claim",
      "integration_owner_id": "enforced-planning",
      "scope": {
        "included": [
          "Sanctioned blocker-session entrypoint",
          "Scoped blocker receipt persistence",
          "Scoped handoff or retirement of one goal root and descendants",
          "Installed wrapper generation",
          "End-to-end A/B/C and true-blocker lifecycle tests"
        ],
        "excluded": [
          "Automatic takeover or deletion",
          "Ending unrelated roots owned by the same runtime",
          "Workspace bootstrap edit",
          "Fleet deadline tuning"
        ]
      },
      "inputs": [
        {
          "kind": "work_unit_output",
          "id": "npw-01-progress-lease-current-main",
          "revision": "accepted"
        },
        {
          "kind": "work_unit_output",
          "id": "npw-02-provider-free-blocker-decision",
          "revision": "accepted"
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Sanctioned blocker disposition and scoped lifecycle command",
        "Installed consumer wrappers",
        "End-to-end receipts for continue-ready-work and true-blocker paths"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        {
          "unit_id": "npw-01-progress-lease-current-main",
          "type": "hard",
          "gate": {
            "type": "unit_status",
            "required_status": "accepted"
          },
          "rationale": "Lifecycle application must preserve the accepted progress-versus-liveness state model."
        },
        {
          "unit_id": "npw-02-provider-free-blocker-decision",
          "type": "hard",
          "gate": {
            "type": "unit_status",
            "required_status": "accepted"
          },
          "rationale": "Ownership changes may consume only an accepted deterministic disposition."
        }
      ],
      "conflict_surfaces": [
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "enforced_planning/session_lifecycle.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-lifecycle-integration"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "enforced_planning/coordination_claims.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-lifecycle-integration"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "scripts/install_governed_repo.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-lifecycle-integration"
        },
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": "tests/test_session_cli.py",
          "repository": "enforced-planning",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "npw-lifecycle-integration"
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        {
          "id": "NPW03-A1",
          "criterion": "One installed command denies a whole-goal block while a unit is ready and safely records and retires only the selected goal scope for a verified true blocker.",
          "evidence_required": [
            "End-to-end fixture receipt for continue_ready_work",
            "End-to-end fixture receipt for goal_blocked_verified",
            "Installed-wrapper parity test",
            "Idempotent replay and dirty-work preservation tests"
          ],
          "negative_control": "An unrelated authorized root remains active and no dirty worktree, branch or claim is deleted, rebased or taken over."
        }
      ],
      "readiness": {
        "status": "blocked",
        "required_approval_types": [],
        "approvals": [],
        "failed_guards": [
          "npw-01-progress-lease-current-main must be accepted",
          "npw-02-provider-free-blocker-decision must be accepted"
        ]
      },
      "claim_policy": {
        "eligibility_rule": "Both provider units are accepted and one integration claim exclusively owns their shared lifecycle and installer paths.",
        "lease_policy": "renewable",
        "lease_duration_minutes": 1440,
        "max_active_per_claimant": 1,
        "named_owner_id": null
      },
      "status": "blocked",
      "record_version": 1
    },
    {
      "schema_version": "1.0",
      "record_type": "work_unit",
      "id": "npw-04-workspace-bootstrap-integration",
      "initiative_id": "coordination-integrity",
      "goal_id": "no-passive-waiting",
      "design_revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c",
      "spec_revision": "npw-04-v1",
      "title": "Integrate the compact workspace no-passive-waiting instruction",
      "class": "integration",
      "objective": "Add one compact universal instruction that routes agents to the enforced blocker lifecycle without conflicting with the concurrently implemented ecosystem-feedback instruction.",
      "profile": "standard",
      "execution_class": "coupled",
      "claimability": "blocked_dependencies",
      "authorization_mode": "registry_claim",
      "integration_owner_id": "project-meta",
      "scope": {
        "included": [
          "Canonical workspace bootstrap source edit after feedback-lane integration",
          "Generated instruction-surface synchronization",
          "One navigation test showing both compact instructions"
        ],
        "excluded": [
          "Feedback command or register implementation",
          "Duplicating detailed blocker policy in every repository",
          "Editing another agent's active branch or claim"
        ]
      },
      "inputs": [
        {
          "kind": "work_unit_output",
          "id": "npw-03-safe-lifecycle-integration",
          "revision": "accepted"
        },
        {
          "kind": "external_integration",
          "id": "project-meta-universal-feedback-bootstrap",
          "revision": "pending"
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "One canonical workspace instruction covering no-passive-waiting",
        "Synchronized generated instruction surfaces",
        "Navigation and non-duplication evidence"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        {
          "unit_id": "npw-03-safe-lifecycle-integration",
          "type": "hard",
          "gate": {
            "type": "unit_status",
            "required_status": "accepted"
          },
          "rationale": "The workspace instruction must point to a real installed lifecycle capability."
        }
      ],
      "conflict_surfaces": [
        {
          "kind": "repository_path",
          "target": ".claude/CLAUDE.md canonical workspace bootstrap source",
          "repository": "project-meta",
          "access": "exclusive",
          "coordination_key": "workspace-bootstrap-feedback-and-waiting"
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        {
          "id": "NPW04-A1",
          "criterion": "The always-loaded workspace instruction tells agents to evaluate ready work before reporting blocked and to record a precise blocker/resume event, while preserving the accepted feedback-routing instruction.",
          "evidence_required": [
            "Canonical-source diff",
            "Instruction-surface sync check",
            "Navigation test for both feedback and blocker routes"
          ],
          "negative_control": "No derived AGENTS.md is hand-edited and neither compact instruction duplicates the other's detailed implementation."
        }
      ],
      "readiness": {
        "status": "blocked",
        "required_approval_types": [],
        "approvals": [],
        "failed_guards": [
          "npw-03-safe-lifecycle-integration must be accepted",
          "the project-meta universal-feedback bootstrap claim must be integrated or released"
        ]
      },
      "claim_policy": {
        "eligibility_rule": "Claim only after the active workspace-bootstrap feedback lane is integrated or released and NPW-03 is accepted.",
        "lease_policy": "renewable",
        "lease_duration_minutes": 1440,
        "max_active_per_claimant": 1,
        "named_owner_id": null
      },
      "status": "blocked",
      "record_version": 1
    },
    {
      "schema_version": "1.0",
      "record_type": "work_unit",
      "id": "npw-05-fleet-observation",
      "initiative_id": "coordination-integrity",
      "goal_id": "no-passive-waiting",
      "design_revision": "405f7423f9e5673185cea604a8d594d68d69c85c",
      "spec_revision": "npw-05-v1",
      "title": "Observe stalled-lane usefulness without enabling takeover",
      "class": "verification",
      "objective": "Classify real stalled reports and determine whether the reporting deadline or instrumentation needs adjustment without changing ownership semantics.",
      "profile": "standard",
      "execution_class": "independently_executable",
      "claimability": "blocked_dependencies",
      "authorization_mode": "registry_claim",
      "scope": {
        "included": [
          "Read-only fleet status capture",
          "Classification as genuine stall, legitimate quiet work, missing instrumentation or noisy threshold",
          "Bounded recommendation on reporting configuration"
        ],
        "excluded": [
          "Automatic takeover, deletion or reassignment",
          "Model-based progress scoring",
          "Changing blocker semantics from an observational sample"
        ]
      },
      "inputs": [
        {
          "kind": "work_unit_output",
          "id": "npw-04-workspace-bootstrap-integration",
          "revision": "accepted"
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "Timestamped read-only stalled-lane observation set",
        "Per-case classification and evidence references",
        "Keep, tune or repair-instrumentation recommendation"
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        {
          "unit_id": "npw-04-workspace-bootstrap-integration",
          "type": "hard",
          "gate": {
            "type": "unit_status",
            "required_status": "accepted"
          },
          "rationale": "Observation is meaningful only after the runtime and compact agent instruction are installed together."
        }
      ],
      "conflict_surfaces": [
        {
          "kind": "external_system",
          "target": "shared coordination claim registry",
          "access": "read",
          "coordination_key": "npw-fleet-observation"
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        {
          "id": "NPW05-A1",
          "criterion": "Every observed stalled row steps down to one exact claim and is classified with evidence without mutating any claim or worktree.",
          "evidence_required": [
            "Timestamped registry snapshot",
            "Per-case evidence and classification",
            "Explicit stopping rule and recommendation"
          ],
          "negative_control": "The observation command performs zero claim, branch, worktree or tracker mutations."
        }
      ],
      "readiness": {
        "status": "blocked",
        "required_approval_types": [],
        "approvals": [],
        "failed_guards": [
          "npw-04-workspace-bootstrap-integration must be accepted"
        ]
      },
      "claim_policy": {
        "eligibility_rule": "NPW-04 is accepted; claim only the read-only evidence output path.",
        "lease_policy": "renewable",
        "lease_duration_minutes": 1440,
        "max_active_per_claimant": 1,
        "named_owner_id": null
      },
      "status": "blocked",
      "record_version": 1
    }
  ]
}

licensed_claim: At candidate revision 57863d6cbd596348f42427d21c80d8fb124cec27, the read-only provider-free evaluator recomputed source-bound ready queues, continued eligible work, isolated exact local ownership conflicts, diagnosed a complete supported blocker without authorizing mutation, and returned control unverified for missing, stale, malformed, fabricated, or below-threshold evidence.
limitations: NPW-02 produces diagnostic dispositions only; application_authorized remains false.
NPW-03 must atomically reload canonical claims and graph bytes, recompute both stable IDs, and issue a separate application receipt before any ownership mutation.
Mailbox evidence remains fixture-only in this slice because the public CLI rejects caller-supplied mailbox state until a canonical loader owns it.
No installer, host hook activation, downstream repository, colleague, or fleet enforcement changed in this work unit.
